thrustRule.name: C2
thrustRule.formula: |a| = min(|w|, max_i|w_i| / max_i|u_i|); w_i = u_i * G_i(direction)

fullStrafeForwardCurve.note: boosted, full lateral strafe, forward fraction -> settled speed (m/s). Rule-A direction holds except 0.4-0.75.
fullStrafeForwardCurve.effectiveForwardG_note: Derived: forward G that, with 12.9 G lateral, points thrust at the measured settle angle (limacon inverse). Rule A would be u*21.1.

corkscrewAtWall.note: V1 excludes rotation; kept for V2.

gloc: Per-direction tolerance, not one G limit (see glocTrials). SCM strafe + full roll from rest, no grey within 20 s at: up 2.5/5/6.5/7.5 G, lateral 2.5/5 G, down 2.5/3.7 G. Greys out at: up 10 G (4.4 s), lateral 7.5 G (7.4 s) and 10 G (1.7-2.1 s), down 5 G (3.4-3.6 s, red-out). Boost itself is not the cause (equal-G boosted and SCM pairs agree within 0.25 s). A boosted launch from rest (~21 G forward) greys out in ~2 s. While fully blacked out the ship stops responding and boost drops (speed bleeds to the SCM cap); the HUD returned ~4 s after the load stopped (lateral) or 4-4.5 s after the blackout began with the stick held (boosted down); unsettled which applies.

boostRelease.note: All inputs and boost released while moving ~514 m/s near the boosted nose wall; IFCS decelerates toward the SCM cap. [t after release, speed, G meter] Inputs were released at t=0; the HUD shows the response ~0.3 s later (game/HUD latency). (Round 1 trace, 1.4 s only; superseded for the tail by releaseTraces, session 20261008-133222.)

lateralRoom.note: Boost egg cross-section radius (max sideways speed) at a given forward speed; SCM sphere: sqrt(225^2 - v_fwd^2).

dimensions_note: V1 glyph uses 20 x 17 x 5.5 m (author-specified, matches spviewer); scunpacked lists 21 x 17.5 x 5.5.

released_at_440.note: boost released at 440 m/s (summary.csv rel_start_mps mis-sampled); peaked 457 before the bleed

released_at_338.note: boost released at 338 m/s; peaked 367 before the bleed

releaseTraces._note: Boost released above SCM. (r7_spacebrake_nose is here as a SECOND RELEASE trace: the harness never pressed the spacebrake in it, see invalid.) samples = [t seconds after the inputs start, HUD speed m/s] every 0.25 s; the HUD lags the ship by ~0.3 s. steps give the release time. Samples after the last step are the harness cleanup, not the manoeuvre.

turnTraces._note: Boost to the nose wall (~510 m/s), then turn a known angle with the stated stick; pitch 1.0 for t s at the boosted pitch rate 81.6 deg/s (SCM 68), yaw at 62.7. The velocity stays put in space, so the ship-frame velocity swings and the IFCS bleeds it onto the egg. Samples after the last step are harness cleanup. turn180_boosted (r10_turn180_boost) did not settle before boost ended (still ~285 and falling) and is not a 180 deg radius.

throttleTraces._note: The forward axis is the game's Throttle - Forward / Back: deflection gives acceleration in proportion (25 % -> 3.4 G, 50 % -> 6.9 G) up to the cap. The game keeps a throttle setting after the axis returns to centre (throttlecheck.log); a short tap back clears it.

redoutTraces._note: Boosted full down held through a red-out. Speed climbs to ~250, the screen goes black and the speed stops rising and falls back toward the SCM cap (boost and thrust cut), then it accelerates again when vision returns (~4.5 s later).

referenceManoeuvres._note: Held back for validating the simulator (not fitted). Ref escape: boost run-up then forward + up + roll 50 %; ref jink: forward with left/right reversal; ref diag turn: boosted pitch 0.7 + yaw 1.0.

eggSettle._note: Boosted settle speed after turning at ~510 to the stated heading of the velocity relative to the nose, boost held. limacon = 394 + 126 cos(heading).

rows.note: yaw 2.15 s at 62.7 deg/s = 134.8 deg; limacon 305 at 135, 300 at 138

rotationChecks._note: Nose turn rates from the forward-thrust rotation gauge (fits within 0.3 m/s). Predictions: independent axes, capped at the best axis, stick scaled to unit length.

glocTrials._note: Time from the input start to the HUD digits at 80 % (greyAt), below 50 % (hudGoneAt) and the screen half dark (dark50At); null = not reached within the test. gPeak is the HUD G meter peak (steady side G for the strafe + full-roll tests; rows with forwardLaunch greyed out during the ~19-21 G boosted run-up from rest, so their gPeak is the earlier forward peak). Not a CIG rule: a per-direction tolerance with onset time falling as G rises, ~4 s recovery. Forward (eyeballs-in) tolerance is not mapped.

invalid.r7_spacebrake_nose: The round-7 'spacebrake' test never braked: sctest/runner.py hard-coded brake=False in the in-test pad (fixed 2026-10-09), commands.csv has no brake column, and the speed falls exactly as in a plain release. It is a second release-from-the-nose trace. What the spacebrake does is not measured (round 12 re-flies it). Found by the sc-flight-coach review, docs/coach-review-2026-10-09.md.
invalid.r4_boost_down.plateau: The harness let go at red-out (old 'release' policy) after 2.8 s; the 76 m/s 'plateau' is not a measurement. Its acceleration (6.8 G) stands.

forwardAxis: The forward axis is the game's 'Throttle - Forward / Back' (there is no forward strafe binding): thrust proportional to deflection (25 % -> 3.4 G, 50 % -> 6.9 G, then to the cap); the game keeps a throttle setting after the axis returns to centre. Source: r10_thr_025/050/100_release, throttlecheck.log.
